description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing user resources, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting users. It requires authentication and administrative privileges for certain operations, and interacts with User and Activity models.

methods.name: requireAdmin(req, res, next)
methods.description: Middleware function that restricts access to admin users only.

methods.name: GET /users
methods.description: Lists all users, accessible only by admin.

methods.name: POST /users
methods.description: Creates a new user, requires admin privileges.

methods.name: GET /users/:id
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific user, accessible by admin or the user themselves.

methods.name: PUT /users/:id
methods.description: Updates user information, accessible by admin or the user themselves with restrictions.

methods.name: DELETE /users/:id
methods.description: Deletes a user, restricted to admin users.
